summary: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd filed a Form 6-K providing notice of an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) to be held virtually on May 20, 2026. The sole proposal is to increase authorized share capital from US$50,000 to US$200,000 by raising the number of authorized ordinary shares from 1.25 billion to 5 billion (split into Class A and Class B shares). The board recommends a FOR vote. No price, premium, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine capital-authorization proposal, not a special-situation transaction. There is no event-driven angle; watch for shareholder approval and subsequent filing of amended articles.
